title: Team Chat: Claude can attach files to a post, and save web pages to My files
text: Claude can now attach a file from My files (the From Claude folder) to a Team Chat / TD Talk post, up to 5 files per message. The file is copied so its link opens without a login, and if any file is refused nothing is posted. Claude's My files save tools also accept web pages (.html) now.
points: Files outside the From Claude folder, and risky types such as scripts, programs and web pages, are refused for attaching.
Only Antonio's own Claude session can attach files from My files.
Every public copy is recorded in an audit log.
